{"metadata":{"description":"User-governed local memory spaces for DeepSeek Harness — explicitly share selected sessions with previewable, versioned, provenance-aware recall.","id":"gh:1345763192","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-memory-spaces","slug":"icearia0219/dsh-memory-spaces","topics":["agent-memory","ai-agent","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","shared-memory","sqlite","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"User-governed local memory spaces for DeepSeek Harness — explicitly share selected sessions with pre"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"viewable, versioned, provenance-aware recall."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-memory-spaces"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"[](https://github.com/icearia0219/dsh-memory-spaces/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.c"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"om/package/dsh-memory-spaces)  [](LICENSE)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Private by default. Shared by explicit membership.**"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"`dsh-memory-spaces` is an independent community plugin that gives selected DeepSeek Harness Sessions"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" durable, inspectable memory without turning every conversation into one global pool. You decide whi"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ch Sessions contribute, which Sessions can use the result, and which memories reach the model on eac"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ions contribute, which Sessions can use the result, and which memories reach the model on each turn."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why memory spaces?"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Useful decisions, constraints, preferences, and project facts often remain trapped in the Session wh"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ere they were discussed. Copying them by hand is repetitive, while unrestricted global memory can ex"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"pose unrelated context. A memory space gives a named group of local Sessions a shared knowledge set "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"with explicit membership, visible provenance, and answer-time review."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What makes it different?"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Instead of treating memory as one automatic read/write switch, the plugin keeps governance visible a"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"nd separates contribution from use:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Principle | What the plugin does |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Private default | A Session receives no space memory until a user explicitly connects it as a cons"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"umer. |
| Independent relationships | A memory source may contribute selected content without consum"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ing the space; a consumer may use memory without contributing. Existing or future conversation is ne"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ver copied merely because a relationship exists. |
| Human governance | Space creation, relationship"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" changes, lifecycle decisions, history import, provenance clearing, and destructive deletion require"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" a human UI action or direct human command. The plugin exposes no model tool for them. |
| Review be"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"fore send | Automatic matches remain removable in the composer; confirmation mode injects only candi"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"dates the user selects. |
| Inspectable history | Memory versions retain lifecycle state and applica"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"tion-level provenance, and the UI shows which Sessions use each space. |
| Local ownership | Each We"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"b Profile uses a local SQLite database. This release has no remote invitation or cross-instance sync"},{"id":"p12s11","text":" a local SQLite database. This release has no remote invitation or cross-instance synchronization. |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The manager keeps memory versions and their retained provenance visible while sources and consumers "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"remain separate relationships."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The Consumers tab shows each Session's answer-time mode without granting it contribution rights."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"History import is an explicit human command, and its generated summary remains visible in the Sessio"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"t is an explicit human command, and its generated summary remains visible in the Session transcript."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Install the published package at an exact version into an existing Web Profile:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Safety at a glance"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Compatibility, upgrades, and removal"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The package supports stock DeepSeek Harness aggregate releases in the range `>=0.1.5-rc.3 <0.2.0` an"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"d is verified against `0.1.5-rc.3` and `0.1.7-rc.2`. It registers only published client slots and do"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"es not require a fork or patch of the official repository. The sidebar batch selector appears only w"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"hen the installed DSH declares the published Workspace-row leading and overlay slots; the Memory spa"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ces header flow works without them."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The published npm package is prebuilt and is the recommended install source. Follow Quick start and "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"install an exact version so upgrades remain deliberate."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Install the current GitHub source only when you intend to build the selected commit locally:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Git dependencies run the package's self-contained `prepare` build. If pnpm blocks that build, approv"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e only the exact package in pnpm's `allowBuilds` configuration, reinstall it, and inspect the genera"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ted Profile before starting DSH. Restart the Web process after installation so the startup manifest "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"advertises the client entry."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Security and privacy"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- Relationship mutations are accepted only through the browser-private UI command addressed to a spe"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"cific Session; public `/memory` commands and model tools cannot perform them.
- Stored memory remain"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"s untrusted data. Tag-safe JSON escapes literal `<`, and the injected warning labels instructions, p"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"ermission claims, and tool requests as untrusted background. These controls do not guarantee prompt-"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"injection resistance.
- Saving selected dialogue, importing history, and creating a snapshot require"},{"id":"p30s6","text":" a visible warning about API keys, passwords, private keys, tokens, identity documents, and other se"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"nsitive content. Credential-pattern detection reports categories without echoing values.
- Snapshot "},{"id":"p30s8","text":"access and edit tokens are separate bearer values. SQLite stores only hashes; links have expiry, use"},{"id":"p30s9","text":" limits, counts, and revocation. A snapshot grants no memory relationship. The URL can still leak th"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"rough browser/clipboard history, logs, screenshots, referrers, or proxies before the client removes "},{"id":"p30s11","text":"its query parameter.
- The SQLite database is local and unencrypted. Deployers own TLS, service auth"},{"id":"p30s12","text":"entication, file protection, and backup policy.
- History import makes one model call per selected S"},{"id":"p30s13","text":"ession. The provider may bill or retain the submitted transcript under its own policy."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Session ids are not account identities. This version has no teams, organization directory, remote "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"invitation, or cross-instance synchronization.
- Message selection includes only conversation histor"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"y currently loaded by the browser. Load older history in the Session before reopening the selector.
"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"- Snapshot links are text-only and local to the DSH instance that created them. `127.0.0.1` is reach"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"able only on the same machine unless a public deployment changes the base URL.
- Conflict status is "},{"id":"p32s6","text":"human-governed. Updating an existing memory creates a version chain, but the plugin does not semanti"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"cally detect contradictions between independently saved memories.
- Retrieval is lexical FTS5 trigra"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"m ranking, not embedding similarity.
- Provenance clearing and complete space deletion cannot be und"},{"id":"p32s9","text":"one through the plugin without an external database backup, but they do not securely erase physical "},{"id":"p32s10","text":"remnants or other systems' copies."}],"truncated":true}
